## Libraries
```{r import libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(sjPlot)
library(performance)
library(ggeffects)

```

## Data Wranging
```{r Data Wrangling}
# Data across all weeks
weekly <- read_xlsx("Brewers Plots/DataFiles/Capstone Data_4_20.xlsx", sheet = "Weekly Brewers Bay monitoring")
weekly$Date <- as.Date(weekly$Date)

# Selecting the first week and last week of data collection
before__after <- weekly%>% 
  filter(Date %in% c("2026-02-28", "2026-04-18"))

# Extracting the width, length, height one time measurements
onetime <- read_xlsx("Brewers Plots/DataFiles/Capstone Data_4_20.xlsx", sheet = "One Time Measurements") %>% 
  select(-Date)

# Joining one time data across all weeks and selecting columns
brewers_weekly<- weekly %>%
  left_join(onetime, by = "Plot ID") %>% 
  select("Date", "Plot ID":"Grwth/O", "Hedging Type", "N Length (cm)":"W Width (cm)") 

brewers_weekly <- brewers_weekly %>%
  rename("Hedging.Type" = "Hedging Type",
         "Meets.Hedge" = "Meets Hedge")

# Joining one time data wiht only data the first week and last week and selcting columns
brewers <- before__after %>%
  left_join(onetime, by = "Plot ID") %>% 
  select("Date", "Plot ID":"Grwth/O", "Hedging Type", "N Length (cm)":"W Width (cm)") 

# Finding total volume of the hedge (how much space did it take up)
brewers$totalvolumne_m3 <- 
  ((brewers$`N Length (cm)` *  brewers$`N Height (cm)` *  brewers$`N Width (cm)`) + (brewers$`E Length (cm)` *  brewers$`E Height (cm)` *  brewers$`E Width (cm)`) + (brewers$`S Length (cm)` *  brewers$`S Height (cm)` *  brewers$`S Width (cm)`) + (brewers$`W Length (cm)` *  brewers$`W Height (cm)` *  brewers$`W Width (cm)`)) / 1000000

```

## Data Visualization
```{r}
## Weekly plot
ggplot(brewers_weekly) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = Date, y = `Meets Hedge`, color = as.factor(`Hedging Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,1)) +
  theme_bw()

## meets before/after plot
ggplot(brewers) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = Date, y = `Meets Hedge`, color = as.factor(`Hedging Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  theme_bw()

## Total Volume against Meets Hedge only on last day
ggplot(filter(brewers, Date == "2026-04-18")) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = `totalvolumne_m3`, y = `Meets Hedge`, color = as.factor(`Hedging Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  theme_bw()

## Total Volume against Growth Over
ggplot(filter(brewers, Date == "2026-04-18")) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = `totalvolumne_m3`, y = `Grwth/O`, color = as.factor(`Hedging Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  theme_bw()

## Total Volume against Growth Under
ggplot(filter(brewers, Date == "2026-04-18")) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = `totalvolumne_m3`, y = `Grwth/U`, color = as.factor(`Hedging Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  theme_bw()

```

## Graphing
```{r}
## Hedging Proportion over time
prop_weekly <- brewers_weekly %>% 
  group_by(Date, `Hedging.Type`) %>% 
  summarize(
    prop_meets = mean(`Meets.Hedge`)
  ) %>% 
  filter(Date >= as.Date("2026-02-28") &
         Date <= as.Date("2026-04-18"))
prop_weekly$prop <- (prop_weekly$prop_meets * 3)/15
  
#***Hedging Proportion over time***
ggplot(prop_weekly, aes(factor(Date), prop, fill = `Hedging.Type`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) format(as.Date(x), "%m/%d/%y"))+
  xlab("Date")+
  ylim(0, 1)+
  ylab(expression(paste("Proportion of Plots where ", italic("H. stipulacea"), " Meets the Hedge")))+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Hedging Type", labels = c(
    "B" = "Bottles",
    "C" = "Control",
    "G" = "Glass",
    "M" = "Coral & Mesh",
    "R" = "Coral Rubble"
  ))+
    theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17)
  )


## total = total number of plot availabe 15 

```

## Including time
```{r}
# predicting the day at which the seagrass meets the head (like octopus example)

# Calulating the days since the start of the data collection
brewers_weekly$day <- brewers_weekly$Date - brewers_weekly$Date[1]
# number of days since starting is now the response variable
brewers_weekly$day <- as.numeric(brewers_weekly$day)
  
## Meets Hedge with time
meetsmodeltime <- glm(`Meets.Hedge` ~ `Hedging.Type` + day, family = "binomial", data = brewers_weekly)
summary(meetsmodeltime)

check_model(meetsmodeltime)
check_overdispersion(meetsmodel)
```
